LanguageData.CVG_Setting_WuxiaRocks: Wuxia world: map tiles use only wuxia rocks
LanguageData.CVG_Setting_WuxiaRocksTip: With a resources module that adds wuxia rocks (ten tribulations rock, black jade, cloud stone…), each world tile chooses its rock types only among them. Off: they mix with the vanilla rocks. Applies to newly generated maps.
